versions.changelog: Update API key setup and request routing

- Changed credential storage: now uses only a local api_key file in the skill directory and no longer checks environment variables or user home paths.
- Added .clawhubignore to ensure private runtime files (like api_key) are excluded from version control.
- Updated workflow and credential handling instructions in SKILL.md to reflect the new directory-local api_key file policy.
- Removed scripts/sync_official_api_reference.py and skill-card.md.

- Removed the file: skill-card.md.
- Added strict instructions to include the internal routing parameter sourceType in every ComPDF API request, while ensuring it is never exposed in any user-facing content or examples.

- Removed the skill-card.md file.
- Updated the ComPDF portal referral link in the API Key section to use "clawhub" as the source and platform parameters.

- Initial release of ComPDF Encrypt & Decrypt PDF skill.
- Encrypt PDF files with AES-128, AES-256, or RC4; set passwords and permissions.
- Decrypt PDFs (authorization required), supporting removal of password protection for internal use.
- Strictly respects user authorization and document privacy.
- Uses a private local API key file for authentication without exposing keys in chat.
- User guidance provided for API key setup if missing or unreadable.
